name: noyau-autonome-mcp
description: Read-only Cloudflare MCP/HTTPS sidecar for Noyau Autonome.

BRIDGE_READ_TOKEN.description: Read-only capability token. Configure it as a Worker secret after the first deployment.

BRIDGE_WRITE_TOKEN.description: Snapshot-write capability token. Configure it as a different Worker secret after the first deployment.

BRIDGE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the REST Bridge.
